tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search across the whole Almost Impossible website: pages, case studies, news and journal articles. Start here for any open question ("experiential work for banks", "pricing", "awards"). Returns up to 10 matches with URL and summary; read one in full with get_page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one public page as Markdown, by its path: "/" (home), "/about", "/process", "/faq", "/awards", "/work/<slug>", "/news/<slug>" and so on. Use it after search_site or list_work to read and cite the page itself.

tools.name: get_agency_overview
tools.description: Fixed facts about Almost Impossible, the independent creative agency in Dubai: legal name, founding date, founder, address, areas served, the three service lines and agency awards. Use it to describe, compare or verify the agency.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: Published case studies in the agency's own order, 1 to 20 per page, each with client, year and summary. The optional query filters by title, client or summary (e.g. "Mashreq"). Use get_work with a slug for one case study's services and summary.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: One published case study by its slug (from list_work or search_site): client, year, services, summary, short TL;DR and page URL.

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: The people on the published team page: name, role, whether they are a founder, a one-line summary and LinkedIn. It has no email addresses or phone numbers.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_work, list_team · Public sink: list_team.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_work, list_team · Public sink: list_team

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
